snippet.title: Sonic Collision - SAGE 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
This the latest trailer to Sonic Collision!

DOWNLOAD FROM SFGHQ HERE!:

https://www.sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/sonic-collision-movement-showcase-build-sage-26.3291/

What is Sonic Collision?
Sonic Collision is a 3D Sonic fangame evolving the gameplay of the Adventure era. Playing as Sonic, Shadow, and Blaze, you'll use environmental objects and terrain to find new shortcuts and routes.

What Platforms Is It On?
Currently, you can play the latest build on Windows, Mac, Android, Linux, and even Xbox!

How is Sonic Collision different from other Sonic games?
The biggest difference is through Reaction Command system. By pressing LB near an object, the player can use it as a tool to find crazy skips that allow you to express your own playstyle. This is how the level becomes your moveset.

Can I join the development team?
Always! We're always open for people to show their talent on Sonic Collision, if you'd like to join, join the Discord server and fill out the application! You'll get a response in 24 hours or less.


Special thanks to @teleboxyt7070  for composing the 3D cinematics and editing! Check out his remixes on retro soundtracks!


- - - - - - - -
